'''Saigon Buffalo''' is a Vietnamese League of Legends team. They were previously known as '''Dashing Buffalo''' and '''[[Phong Vũ Buffalo]]''' for sponsorship reasons. They were originally known as '''[[Young Generation]]'''.

== History ==

=== 2019 Season ===
Before the summer split, Phong Vũ Buffalo renamed to Dashing Buffalo to match their new sponsor. Additionally star Top laner [[Zeros]] left the team, without their star player the team struggled with new top laners [[Raizo (Lâm Huỳnh Gia Huy)|Raizo]] and [[Kaido]] the team finished 4th with a 8-6 in the [[VCS/2019 Season/Summer Season|VCS Summer Season]] and lost 0-3 in the first round of [[VCS/2019 Season/Summer Playoffs|Playoffs]] to [[Lowkey Esports.Vietnam|Lowkey Esports]]

=== 2020 Season ===
Dashing Buffalo renamed to Saigon Buffalo as Dashing left as sponsor.

=== 2021 Season ===
In the [[VCS/2021 Season/Spring Season|VCS Spring Season]], Saigon Buffalo has promoted four new rookies from their academy team. [[Bean_J|BeanJ]], [[Rby]], [[Arrietty]] and [[Taki (Đinh Anh Tài)|Taki]] would join the team, whereas [[Style (Mai Hoàng Sơn)|Style]], [[Kuroko (Trần Tuấn Anh)|Kuroko]], [[Meliodas (Hoàng Tiến Nhật)|Meliodas]], [[Jad]] and [[Hinn]] left Saigon Buffalo. [[Hasmed]] and [[Froggy]] would remain on the team.
